title: Redis Store fails to deserialize CreateResult
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
Redis Store fails to deserialize CreateResult


**To Reproduce**
```python
    |   File "/home/a1-bconstable/autogen/python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/teams/_group_chat/_base_group_chat.py", line 554, in run_stream
    |     raise RuntimeError(str(message.error))
    | RuntimeError: AssertionError: 
    | Traceback:
    | Traceback (most recent call last):
    | 
    |   File "/home/a1-bconstable/autogen/python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/teams/_group_chat/_chat_agent_container.py", line 133, in handle_request
    |     async for msg in self._agent.on_messages_stream(self._message_buffer, ctx.cancellation_token):
    | 
    |   File "/home/a1-bconstable/autogen/python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/agents/_assistant_agent.py", line 953, in on_messages_stream
    |     async for inference_output in self._call_llm(
    | 
    |   File "/home/a1-bconstable/autogen/python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/agents/_assistant_agent.py", line 1107, in _call_llm
    |     model_result = await model_client.create(
    |                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    | 
    |   File "/home/a1-bconstable/autogen/python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/cache/_chat_completion_cache.py", line 175, in create
    |     assert isinstance(cached_result, CreateResult)
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    | 
    | AssertionError
    | 
    +------------------------------------
```

**Expected behavior**
Cache should work as expected
